facts_found: When a debit card shows pin_locked = TRUE, agents must perform the comprehensive fraud risk assessment in the PIN Lock Investigation Protocol before unlocking, and must not reveal the specific calculations to the user. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Unlocking is performed by the agent (customer service / chat agent) after identity verification; the customer cannot self-unlock a PIN-locked card per the documented procedure. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

If pin_lock_reason = 'security_hold', the card cannot be unlocked by chat agents; the agent must offer to transfer the customer to the security team for that card. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

If another card on the same account also has pin_locked = TRUE, the agent must finish investigating all cards before any unlock; each card is scored individually and may have different outcomes. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]
If any card on the account was replaced in the last 90 days with issue_reason = 'stolen', enhanced verification is required before unlocking. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Risk score 0-4 (LOW): unlock after standard identity verification. 5-7 (MEDIUM): unlock only after asking 'I see failed PIN attempts on your card. Were those attempts yours?' 8-10 (HIGH): must ask specific location and time questions and unlock only if the customer confirms and gives a satisfactory explanation. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Risk score 11-14 (VERY HIGH): cannot unlock on this call; requires callback verification or enhanced verification (last 4 SSN + security question). Score 15+ (CRITICAL): cannot unlock; check for successful unauthorized transactions and recommend card closure and replacement. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]
If any single risk flag equals 3 points, the case must be escalated to supervisor review regardless of the total score. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Lock frequency in the last 90 days drives post-unlock duties: 0 prior locks = standard unlock; 1 prior lock = must offer PIN lock notifications; 2 prior locks = must offer a PIN reset; 3+ prior locks = cannot unlock, PIN reset required (also scores 3 points). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

The knowledge base documents no maximum number of cards that may be unlocked per customer or per call; the only documented limits are per-card (3+ locks in 90 days blocks unlock) and the requirement to investigate every locked card on an account before unlocking any. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]
If a customer enters an incorrect current PIN 3 times, the card will be temporarily locked. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027]

Decline CODE 55 (Incorrect PIN) and CODE 75 (PIN Tries Exceeded) correspond to pin_locked = TRUE; the card's pin_locked and pin_attempts_remaining fields from the debit card lookup show the status, and the PIN Lock Investigation Protocol must be followed before unlocking. [doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_010]

Decline CODE 83 (Unable to Verify PIN) is a network/technical PIN verification failure, not a wrong PIN and not a PIN lock; the customer should retry, try a signature-based transaction or different terminal, or wait 10-15 minutes. [doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_010]

When a card cannot be unlocked, the agent must check transaction history for successful unauthorized transactions (file dispute, close card, order replacement if found); otherwise offer card closure and replacement, transfer to the security team, or a PIN reset. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

PIN reset (used when unlock is not permitted or offered after repeated locks) requires the customer to be verified, to be the card owner, and the card to be in ACTIVE status; the agent uses reset_debit_card_pin_6284 with card_id, last_4_digits and new_pin after confirming the last 4 digits and collecting a new 4-digit PIN. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027]

A new 4-digit PIN must be exactly 4 digits, cannot be sequential (e.g., 1234, 4321), cannot be all the same digit (e.g., 1111), and cannot be the customer's birth year or birth month/day; PINs are never displayed or read back to customers. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027]
PIN changes/resets take effect immediately; a frozen card must be unfrozen (unfreeze_debit_card_3893) before its PIN can be changed. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_027]

PIN lock status is distinct from card freeze status: unfreezing (unfreeze_debit_card_3893) applies only to cards in FROZEN status and requires a verified customer who owns the card and an OPEN linked checking account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Debit cards are looked up with get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id), which returns card_id, account_id, user_id, card_number_last_4, status, issue_reason, expiration_date, date_issued, daily_purchase_limit and daily_atm_limit; accounts are retrieved with get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847(user_id). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]
Fraud risk scoring uses declined transactions of type 'atm_withdrawal_declined' or 'pos_declined' together with card data and customer verification. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Velocity blocks (a different protection from PIN locks) expire automatically after 30 minutes and can be cleared early by an agent after identity verification using clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892; bank-initiated fraud alerts cannot be cleared by agents. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

Escalate to the security team (transfer_to_human_agents) when the customer cannot verify their identity, reports transactions they did not make, or the agent suspects the caller is not the account holder. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

Enhanced verification as documented for stolen-card cases consists of full name and date of birth, plus last 4 of SSN, plus review of 2-3 recent transactions with the customer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]
